questions.q: Who turned out to be the real bank robber?
choices: A man named James Strand
Detective Fix himself
A clerk at the Bank of England
Colonel Stamp Proctor
questions.evidence: the real bankrobber, a certain James Strand

questions.q: How did public opinion about Phileas Fogg change after the real robber was caught?
choices: People stopped caring about the bet and forgot him
He went from a criminal to an honourable gentleman
People decided he had helped the robber escape
He was blamed for making the police look foolish in public
questions.evidence: now he was an honourable gentleman

questions.q: How did people in London try to get news of Fogg during those three days?
choices: They sent telegrams to America and Asia
They hired a ship to sail out and look for him
They asked the Reform Club to send a search party
They put notices in every newspaper in France
questions.evidence: Telegrams were sent to America and Asia for news of Phileas Fogg.

questions.q: Where did a great crowd gather on Saturday evening?
choices: At the Liverpool railway station platform
Around the Reform Club in Pall Mall
Outside Fogg's house in Saville Row
At the doors of the Bank of England
questions.evidence: A great crowd was collected in Pall Mall and the neighbouring streets

questions.q: Why did Samuel Fallentin say they should not be too hasty to call the bet won?
choices: He had heard a rumour that Fogg had reached Liverpool
Fogg was so punctual he might appear at the last minute
He had secretly bet his own money on Fogg and hoped to win
The club clock was known to run a little too fast
questions.evidence: I should not be surprised if he appeared before us at the last minute

questions.q: Why did Andrew Stuart feel so sure that Fogg had lost?
choices: Fogg's name was not on the China's passenger list
Fix had sent a telegram saying Fogg was in jail in America
A newspaper reported that Fogg had died of a fever in India
Fogg's servant had come to the club that morning to say so
questions.evidence: the name of Phileas Fogg is not among them

questions.q: The five gentlemen agreed to play "a rubber" while they waited. In this chapter, what is a rubber?
choices: A round of the card game
A soft eraser for pencils
A kind of strong drink
A bet on a horse race
questions.evidence: they readily assented to Mr. Fallentin's proposal of a rubber

questions.q: What happened just before the clock reached a quarter before nine?
choices: The players finished their game and went home
Fogg walked in and said, "Here I am, gentlemen!"
A messenger brought a letter from Fogg's bank
The police cleared the crowd away from the doors
